title: dactylorhiza incarnata var. hyphaematodes
intro: Dactylorhiza incarnata var. hyphaematodes, commonly known as the Heart-leaved Coeloglossum or the Western Marsh Orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to the western parts of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza incarnata var. hyphaematodes include reducing inflammation, treating respiratory issues, and acting as a diuretic, making it a popular natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
